brltty_config_path.description: Absolute path to the BRLTTY configuration file.

braille_driver.description: Two-letter driver code for the braille display driver; 'auto' for autodetection.

braille_serial_device.description: Serial device name (e.g., ttyS0, ttyUSB0, ttyACM0) to which the braille display is connected.

braille_driver_params.description: Colon-separated driver:parameters string for braille driver (e.g., ba:Auth=/etc/brlapi.key).

speech_driver.description: Two-letter driver code for the speech synthesizer driver; 'auto' for autodetection.

speech_input_path.description: Path to FIFO/named pipe/socket for external TTS requests.

speech_driver_params.description: Colon-separated driver:parameters string for speech driver (e.g., en:Voice=en).

pcm_device.description: Path to PCM sound device (ALSA: 'pcm-handle-id' syntax supported).

midi_device.description: Path to MIDI device (ALSA: 'client:port' syntax supported).

log_file.description: Path to log file (if not specified, system log is used).
